meta.author: claude
meta.description: Well, level 1 of 3: shell and fittings (what soldiers build first). Round stone well: octagon cobblestone basin with stair-rounded corners, dark oak posts and windlass with a chain; L2 adds the spruce gable roof and crank, L3 flowers, a water tub, moss and lanterns. 5 x 5 x 6, water by the decoration step. Decoration step adds: water.
meta.changes: Turned the roof so it slopes to the front: the posts stand left and right of the basin, so the well is no longer hidden behind a post from the front. The roof is narrower and higher (over the axle only), so the rim is open. L1 adds a barrel, L2 a lantern under a gable bracket, L3 two more lanterns.
